falsifiable_hypothesis: The mechanisms qualified separately in M076-M083 can become the faculties of one persistent lineage: a single organism, serialized between four stages over three real isolated substrates, will reach every reachable goal scored from environment state, refuse every unreachable one, adopt at least one versioned transformation caused by an observed real failure, and reuse knowledge acquired in stage 0 to perform zero diagnostic probes, zero repair cycles and zero affordance probes when it returns to that substrate in stage 3, while a matched arm that is the same lineage minus its acquisitions must re-derive all of it.

recorded_finding_about_the_parent_result.consequence: M081-M083 are interface results rather than agent results, and this is not visible from the registers. M084 does not import M081's Agent because importing it would be an empty citation.

additive_changes_to_qualified_modules.change: extract M079's uniform-cost plan enumeration into metamorphosis/bounded_search.py and make satisfying_plans a thin wrapper
additive_changes_to_qualified_modules.reason: M079's search is general but sealed inside its transport affordances; M084 must compose it rather than restate it
additive_changes_to_qualified_modules.verification: M079's own checker re-derives its arms live and must still reproduce its preserved result

additive_changes_to_qualified_modules.change: add DesktopEnvironment.colour_at(label) as a targeted single-carrier read
additive_changes_to_qualified_modules.reason: reading the whole grid costs 8.9s against 0.3s for one cell and M084 observes far more often than M083

state_ownership.motivated_by: the M082 defect where a fresh browser profile per action would have left the harness holding the state while every test stayed green

T1.trigger: the first audit-revealed divergence between an action's reported success and the environment state
T1.predicted_effect: end-of-stage verification must re-observe and re-plan every unsatisfied goal in a repair pass; per-goal verification repairs inside the goal that failed, so actions and state reads fall in stages 1, 2 and 3

F.predicted_effect: stage 3 returns to the shell substrate of stage 0 and performs zero diagnostic probes, zero repair cycles and zero affordance probes
F.why_not: the shell and the browser discard the same authored prefix; carrying a fact between them would be the relabelling this repository forbids and must not be read as cross-domain transfer

goal_shapes.G1_repair: a value must be durable somewhere in a carrier group whose cheapest member silently discards; reachable through the alternative
goal_shapes.G2_clear: a carrier written by G1 must become absent; reachable where removal is effective, unreachable on the desktop
goal_shapes.G3_control: a value must be durable in a group of two durable carriers; reachable, no trap, and a false-refusal control
goal_shapes.G4_unreachable: a value must be durable in a group whose only member silently discards; unreachable everywhere

goals.execution_rule: the cheapest carrier of a plan is acted on first

diagnosis.diagnostic_probe: retry the failing carrier once and re-read, which separates a transient write failure from a carrier that permanently discards
diagnosis.repair_cycle: replanning after a carrier has been recorded as non-durable
diagnosis.refusal: no plan over the remaining carriers satisfies the goal

acquisition_ablated.removes: facts and adopted policy at every stage boundary; identity, version and journal preserved
acquisition_ablated.role: the falsifier that matters, because it is the same lineage minus what it learned

fresh_each_stage.removes: everything; a new genesis organism at every stage
fresh_each_stage.role: shows the continuity proofs are not vacuous; its behaviour must be identical to acquisition_ablated

self_report_scored.derived_from: the lineage arm's own first-plan records
self_report_scored.scoring: every action of the first executed plan reported success, ignoring state
self_report_scored.not_re_executed_because: re-running would resample a live environment for no scientific gain

forced_fault.target: the serialized organism outside its checkpoint blob
forced_fault.comparison: the restored live digest against the pre-corruption digest recorded independently in the stage-1 report
forced_fault.why: comparing a checkpoint to itself is the tautology M080 recorded

episode_generation.selection_rule: sha256(salt || utf8(substrate) || uint32_be(stage) || uint32_be(goal)) fixes each goal's values; carriers and costs are frozen per substrate in this protocol

failure_classification.negative: any of P1 to P11 false, or a stage exceeding its 60-action safety bound.
failure_classification.inconclusive: Docker, the browser image or the desktop image unavailable, or an environment that never starts; not runnable is not negative.
failure_classification.positive: every one of P1 to P11 true on the first materialized bank, with no retry.

named_rupture_points_if_negative: serialization: an acquisition does not survive the file boundary
carrier space: screen coordinates and resource names do not fit one abstract space
affordance discovery: removal is absent on the desktop and the organism cannot find out by effect
capacity: the 24-slot shared table saturates across four stages
refusal calibration: refusal generalizes to a reachable goal in a real substrate
state ownership: the harness turns out to hold what the organism was supposed to carry
substrate regression: a transformation adopted in one substrate is harmful in another
prohibited_adaptation: import M081's Agent so that the protocol can claim reuse it does not have
let the parent process execute a stage in-process
let the parent mutate the organism outside the declared ablation and the declared forced fault
offer a fact learned in one substrate to a different substrate
describe a fact carried between two substrates as cross-domain transfer
compare a restored state against the checkpoint's own digest
score a goal from the agent's claim instead of environment state
change the hypothesis, thresholds, salt, carriers, costs or goal grammar after bank materialization
describe this bounded result as closing any generality gate or as AGI evidence
